column1: # Where the Sponge (758) spawns: the owner's picks, 2026-11-05. One row a container of an anomaly core of a map (the project folder); `from` the core's own kinds, `pos` where the container is (x y z, as the Maps tab draws it). The file is replaced whole by the spawn editor's export (spots.py import); srp-026g/scripts/sponge/spots.py makes the edit list artefact-spots-<n>.json of it.
